description.content:
Lists all end users in an organization. It is possible to filter by one of the mutually exclusive parameters: email or phone number. In case both are provided, an error is returned.
Note: Custom attributes are not part of the response at this point. If you need to get custom attributes for a user use the [GET /endusers/{userId}](../End-Users/#tag/End-Users/operation/getEndusersUserid) endpoint
